description: Divides an incoming phasor into steps and repeats a shortened ramp several times inside each step

params.text: Sets how many steps the incoming cycle is divided into, 1 to 64 in whole numbers
Attenuverts the steps CV input, -1 to +1; 5V at full depth covers the whole 1 to 64 range
Sets how many times the ramp repeats inside each step, 1 to 64 in whole numbers
Attenuverts the repeats CV input, -1 to +1; 5V at full depth covers the whole 1 to 64 range

inputs.text: Stuttering happens at 1V or above and the phasor passes through untouched below that; unpatched, stuttering is always on

outputs.text: The stuttered phasor, 0-10V, climbing across the whole cycle but repeating inside each step
A 10V gate over the first half of every repeat
A 0-10V ramp over each repeat on its own, restarting at every repeat

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
